memo: Clock: 19.6 days remain; respond by 2026-08-06. Exemption gate: Screening found likely exemption (SNAP/TANF compliance). member_impact: Good news — because you are already complying with SNAP's work rules, you are deemed to comply with Medicaid's work rules too. One set of rules, not two. You do not need to meet the separate 80-hour Medicaid standard. Here is what to do: send your SNAP case number with the exemption box checked on your response form. Include the program enrollment letter from your county employment program. Everything is due by August 6, 2026. That is 20 days from now. Your hours in the program are documented and ready if the state asks.
recommended_actions: Check the exemption box for 'already meeting SNAP or TANF requirements' on the renewal response form.
Write your SNAP case number in the space provided.
Attach or enclose the program enrollment letter from the county employment program.
